failures.observation: The historical corpus packager copies three oracle libraries and omits the fixed resource-policy module and policy bindings. Its historical launcher also selects the earlier per-query rule.
failures.resolution: The new source kit includes every one of the 14 bound files and the unchanged resource policy. The next cloud controller must select that policy explicitly.

failures.observation: The recovered original calibration package is 99548216 bytes. The first download guard allowed 64 MiB and stopped the read.
failures.resolution: The saved object metadata and expected hash established the exact package. A 128 MiB read bound allowed recovery; the archive hash and both nested oracle hashes matched.

failures.observation: The local Docker client failed to connect to its configured Podman socket.
failures.resolution: The fixed Linux build and small correctness check ran in GitHub CI.

failures.observation: The first draft source extraction wrote every file with the default file mode. LiE make invokes ./make_lie and needs the original execute bit. This was found before native execution.
failures.resolution: Safe extraction now preserves ordinary permission bits. A regression test checks the executable script; two native builds passed.
